frozenContractUnderTest.note: electric_range.json is immutable contract truth for CG-11. Gas evidence may fit, falsify, or document boundary — it may not teach the frozen contract merely by being different.

centerpieceQuestion.question: Is the frozen electric_range contract actually a broader range/oven functional contract, or is it specifically an electric-range ontology?
centerpieceQuestion.framing: This is the centerpiece of CG-11 — not whether gas hardware looks like electric hardware.
allowedOutcomes: gas_fits — frozen contract behaves as generic range/oven functional ontology; organizational rename may follow as separate human gate
gas_fits_with_documented_boundary — instance scope / conditional extensions documented without mutating frozen electric rev1
genuine_divergence — electric and gas require separate canonical contracts; document boundary, do not mutate electric
centerpieceQuestion.disallowedShortcut: Creating gas_range.json or expanding electric_range.json because gas manuals expose igniter/valve vocabulary

immutableRules: CG-11 is fit/falsification only — success includes proving gas does NOT fit the frozen electric contract.

Instance-scope compounding machinery remains deferred until CG-11 boundary decision.

afterR1.doNotAsk: Does Samsung gas match Whirlpool electric?
